verdict.rationale: The pricing docs explicitly say QuickBooks creates and e-files unlimited 1099-MISC/NEC forms and automatically sends copies to contractors. Employees can access their W-2s online or in the app, which implies W-2s are generated and distributed to them, and QuickBooks says it files payroll taxes on the user's behalf. missing for 10: explicit documentation that W-2s are automatically generated and filed at year-end, detail on W-2 distribution beyond self-service portal access, independent or hands-on corroboration.
